title: Midori MD Notebook A5 Blank
description_en: Crafted in Japan with ultra-smooth MD paper that makes every pen glide effortlessly. A simple, beautiful notebook free of branding — the choice of writers and minimalists worldwide.
description_ja: 独自開発のMD用紙は万年筆でもすらすら書けるなめらかさ。余計なロゴを排した潔いデザインが、書くことへの集中を高めます。
